key_insight: EvoArena shows that LLM agents should not only be tested on static tasks, but also on how well they adapt when environments change over time. It frames memory evolution as a core capability for robust real-world agent behavior.
problem_solved: Most LLM evaluations assume fixed conditions, but real deployments face shifting tools, software, terminals, and task requirements. This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for measuring whether agents can keep up with progressive environment updates.
method: Introduces EvoArena, a benchmark suite built around sequences of progressive environment updates.
Evaluates agent robustness across changing settings such as terminal, software, and other dynamic environments.
Tracks how agent memory and behavior evolve as conditions shift, revealing adaptation and forgetting patterns.
impact: This matters because it gives practitioners a more realistic way to measure whether an LLM agent will remain useful after deployment. It can help guide the design of agents with better long-term adaptation, memory management, and resilience to change.
visual_elements: Timeline showing environment updates over time
Pipeline diagram of agent perception, memory update, and action adaptation
Comparison chart of performance in static vs dynamic environments
Icon set for terminal, software, and changing task conditions
paper_title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
paper_authors: Jundong Xu, Qingchuan Li, Jiaying Wu, Yihuai Lan, Shuyue Stella Li
